title: Ed4All trainforge_assessment_quality_report.json
description: Top-level Trainforge assessment-quality aggregator output (Worker W2.B). Aggregates four signals — synthesis-pair quality (training_synthesis gate results), assessment-corpus quality (trainforge_assessment gate results + quality_report.json::assessments dimension), KG quality (libv2_archival gate results), and post-training eval gating (LibV2 adapter eval_report.json) — into a single canonical <libv2_course>/quality/trainforge_assessment_quality_report.json so operators can decide whether the assessment corpus is shippable as training data. Built by lib/aggregators/trainforge_assessment_quality_report.py::TrainforgeAssessmentQualityReport post-workflow. Wave W-D11.A schema pin.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call. Emitter uses datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z' (not strict RFC 3339) so the value is not constrained to format: date-time.

course_code.description: Operator-facing course code so cross-run diffs key cleanly.

status.description: Top-level aggregator status. pass == clean run; warn == warnings only or fully-degraded inputs; fail == any blocking signal fired.

kg_quality.description: Projected libv2_archival KG-quality bucket. Null when no KG gate ran (graceful degradation); the key is always present.

eval_summary.description: Passthrough projection of the most-recently-imported adapter's eval_report.json. Null when no adapter has been imported; the key is always present.

per_question_issues.description: Passthrough rows from quality_report.json::assessments.per_question_issues. Free-form per-row shape (validator-specific issue codes); the aggregator does not constrain row structure.

blocking_failures.description: Critical-severity failed gates aggregated across training_synthesis, trainforge_assessment, and libv2_archival phases.

warnings.description: Warning-severity failed gates aggregated across training_synthesis, trainforge_assessment, and libv2_archival phases.

severity.description: Gate severity (critical | warning) lower-cased on emit.

action.description: GateResult.action when set (e.g. regenerate / escalate / block); null when the validator did not stamp one.

score.description: Gate score float when emitted; null when the validator did not produce one.

code.description: First-issue code (canonical issue identifier); null when issues[] is empty.

message.description: First-issue message; null when issues[] is empty.

total_questions.description: Total question count from quality_report.json::assessments.total_questions; null when the dimension is unavailable.

answerable_rate.description: Retrieval-grounding score (rewrite seam preferred over outline). Null when no retrieval-grounding gate fired.

single_correct_rate.description: distinct_correct_answer_ratio from the assessments dimension, or assessment_quality gate score when the dimension is unavailable; null otherwise.

bloom_alignment_rate.description: Share of questions whose observed Bloom level matched targeted, derived from per_question_issues; null when total_questions is missing.

placeholder_rate.description: Share of questions carrying a placeholder-class issue in per_question_issues; null when total_questions is missing.

synthesis_diversity.description: Projection of training_synthesis::synthesis_diversity; null when the gate did not fire.

synthesis_leakage.description: Projection of training_synthesis::synthesis_leakage; null when the gate did not fire.

curie_anchoring.description: Projection of training_synthesis::curie_anchoring; null when the gate did not fire.

property_coverage.description: Projection of training_synthesis::property_coverage; null when the gate did not fire.

min_edge_count.description: Projection of training_synthesis::min_edge_count; null when the gate did not fire.

evidence_quote.description: Wave W-D11 T11.5 — pair-side claim_support evidence_quote_* rates lifted from the pair_claim_support GateResult.metadata. Always present (zeros when the gate did not fire / lacked metadata) so downstream consumers see a wire-stable block.

gates.description: Per-gate projection rows for libv2_archival KG-quality gates (kg_quality_report, libv2_manifest).

EvalSummary.description: Subset projection of LibV2/courses/<slug>/models/<id>/eval/eval_report.json. Every field is optional — the aggregator only emits keys the source payload carried.

phase.description: Phase name the gate fired against (e.g. training_synthesis, trainforge_assessment, libv2_archival).

gate_id.description: Gate ID; null when the upstream KG-quality row did not carry one.

code.description: First-issue code; null when issues[] was empty.

message.description: First-issue message; null when issues[] was empty.

value.description: Three-way W2.B-internal heuristic. Wave 3 W3.G's master promotion-chain compose supersedes this for course_status; this field stays for back-compat with consumers reading the per-aggregator verdict.

rationale.description: Replayable rationale string interpolating dynamic signals (blocking_failures count, placeholder_rate, answerable_rate, eval-gating signals, total_questions, resolved decision).

contributing_gate_ids.description: Gate IDs that contributed to a 'failed' verdict. Empty for 'trainable' / 'non_certified_archive'.

promotion_rejection_reasons.description: Histogram of rejection reasons keyed by reason name (alphabetised on emit).
